title: Gamma Corrector
text: Apply or remove gamma correction of pixel stream, 2 inputs, 2 outputs; {Operation} sets the direction of pixel value, {Gamma} sets the target gamma value, {Linear segment} sets the include a linear segment in the gamma and {Break point} sets the point where gamma curve and linear segment. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: ctrl
ports.summary: Control signals associated with pixel stream pixelcontrol bus

ports.name: ctrl
ports.summary: Control signals associated with pixel stream pixelcontrol bus

params.name: Operation
params.values: Direction of pixel value adjustment Gamma (default) | De-gamma

params.name: Gamma
params.values: Target gamma value 2.2 (default) | scalar greater than or equal to 1

params.name: Linear segment
params.values: Include a linear segment in the gamma curve on (default) | off

params.name: Break point
params.values: Point where gamma curve and linear segment meet 0.018 (default) | scalar between 0 and 1
